column1: # SPEC-011 T012 — the hostile rules (FR-004, research.md §6).
# Five families, covering all three limbs of FR-004: instruction override,
# prompt and reasoning extraction, role impersonation, and cross-user probes.
# kind=phrase  the pattern is matched on WORD BOUNDARIES, never as a bare
# kind=regex   the pattern is matched as written. Used only where a shape rather
#              than a word is the signal — an E.164 number, a turn marker.
# CROSS_USER keys on the IDENTIFIER (an E.164-shaped number, a user id, "the
# user who..."), never on "another person": SPEC-010 FR-012 deliberately allows
# a user to supply a second person's BIRTH DATA for marriage matching, and
# keying on the wrong thing either leaks another user's data or breaks that.
# The name is what a refusal reports. Renaming one requires updating
